### Nextpower to Hold Capital Markets Day on November 16, 2026


October 12, 2026


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nextpower](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com&esheet=54620643&newsitemid=20261012095559&lan=en-US&anchor=Nextpower&index=1&md5=f2bc2a16a3e715288b280756b1f0c40a) (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power technology solutions, today announced that it will host its Capital Markets Day in Las Vegas, Nevada on Monday, November 16, 2026, beginning at 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time / 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time.


The event will include presentations from Nextpower’s senior leadership team on the Company’s growth strategy and progress against its long-term financial targets, followed by a live Q&A session.


Due to limited capacity, attendance in person is by invitation only. A live webcast of the event will be available on the Nextpower Investor Relations[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextpower.com&esheet=54620643&newsitemid=20261012095559&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=2&md5=60eb4a73ceb3eb88a8f441b67ff49542) . A replay will be posted to the same website shortly after the event concludes.


**About Nextpower**


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) innovates and delivers integrated technology solutions for modern energy infrastructure. Its solar and energy storage platforms help customers design, build, and operate utility-scale power plants and other critical power infrastructure with faster project delivery, improved system performance, greater reliability, and long-term operational value. Building on more than a decade of energy technology leadership, Nextpower partners with customers worldwide to accelerate the deployment of reliable firm power needed for a rapidly electrifying world. Learn more at[www.nextpower.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nextpower.com&esheet=54620643&newsitemid=20261012095559&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nextpower.com&index=3&md5=7b20f24faafe9ff5a849411c4516167c) .
